inference_policy: Inherit unchanged exact revisions, pooling, float32, max_length512, batch16 and inference RNG seed20260711 from the two hash-locked legacy configs. Mapping seeds are a different concept.
join_policy: Use (atomic_id, view, variant) to join the immutable registry to text_id. Same anonymous text can denote different drugs across variants. Only text embeddings are shared; variant/entity semantic assignments must never be merged.
scope: Generate six-model anonymous shared exact-text embeddings only. No anonymous E01/E02/prediction scores; no response/raw access; no model download.
